nodes.text: Run a complete rare disease workup — I have WES and RNA-seq

Microarray Normalization Method Comparison (ExpressionNormalizationWorkflow). Bioc Workflow ExpressionNormalizationWorkflow analog: read raw microarray CEL/IDAT files, normalize with multiple methods (RMA, vsn, lumi, ComBat), compare normalization quality via PCA and variance estimation. For normalization quality comparison and method selection ONLY — NOT for differential expression statistical testing. For differential expression analysis from a normalized microarray count matrix, use nf-core/differentialabundance.

RNA-seq + Epigenomic Integration (fluentGenomics). Bioc Workflow `fluentGenomics` analog: integrate RNA-seq differential genes with ATAC-seq accessibility regions and ChIP-seq TF binding peaks, link peaks to genes via + .

RNA-seq Differential Transcript Usage (rnaseqDTU). Bioc Workflow `rnaseqDTU` analog: quantify transcripts (Salmon), import via tximport, then + DEXSeq + stageR for differential transcript usage with FDR control.

CRISPR guide assignment and cell barcode demultiplexing for Perturb-seq data following Replogle et al. 2022 | CRISPR guide RNA assignment and cell barcode demultiplexing in single-cell Perturb-seq data → single-cell AnnData with assigned guide identities

Perturb-seq hit calling and differential perturbation phenotype identification comparing target guides to non-targeting controls | statistical hit calling comparing perturbed cells to non-targeting controls in single-cell CRISPR screens → significant perturbation hits, effect sizes, and filtered AnnData

Perturbation state representation and dimensionality reduction via scVI and scANVI embedding | deep generative modeling of single-cell perturbation states using scVI and scANVI latent space embeddings → latent representations, cell embeddings, and perturbation state maps

BioMate: Subworkflow Sprint 3 — Pseudotime + RNA velocity from single-cell data Runs two orthogonal trajectory methods in parallel: — graph-based pseudotime (R / Monocle3) — RNA velocity (Python / scVelo) Both processes accept the same AnnData h5ad input but are. 2-step pipeline: → . Inputs: csv, h5ad. Outputs: anndata, csv, h5ad, png. Key parameters: adata_h5ad, monocle_cluster, root_cell, velocity_mode.

IDAT → Normalisation → Differential Methylation → Gene Enrichment. EPIC/450K array methylation from IDAT — minfi load + functional normalisation, DSS differential methylation, missMethyl gene-set enrichment. Use when you want the DSS-based differential-methylation + enrichment wrapper chain. Also applicable to bismark bisulfite coverage from nf-core/methylseq.
predict CYP450 inhibition and hepatic clearance for new chemical entity
Run RNA-seq analysis and differential expression

Identify tumor-reactive T cell phenotypes from single-cell RNA-seq data | identification and scoring of tumor-reactive T cell states from single-cell RNA-seq expression profiles (activation, exhaustion, tissue-resident memory signatures) → annotated T cell subsets and reactivity rankings

Predict tumor neoantigens and MHC binding affinities | neoantigen prediction and peptide-MHC binding affinity scoring from somatic mutations and transcript expression → prioritized candidate neoepitopes

Nanostring GeoMx DSP Analysis (GeoMxWorkflows). Bioc Workflow `GeoMxWorkflows` analog: read Nanostring GeoMx DSP NanoStringGeoMxSet, segment-level QC, Q3 normalization, mixed-model linear DE across regions of interest.

Illumina 450k/EPIC Methylation Array DMR Analysis (methylationArrayAnalysis). Bioc Workflow `methylationArrayAnalysis` analog: read IDAT files via minfi, QC, normalize (SWAN or noob), call DMPs (limma), DMRs (DMRcate), gene-set test (missMethyl).
FDA Phase II to Phase III dose justification brief

Public RNA-seq Reanalysis (recountWorkflow). Bioc Workflow `recountWorkflow` analog: pull uniformly-processed counts from recount2/3 for a study (e.g., SRP), scale counts by read length, run DESeq2 DE with technical replicate handling.
Run Voyager spatial ESDA on this Visium dataset

Estimate human PK parameters from preclinical animal data (rat, mouse, dog) using interspecies allometric scaling | interspecies allometric scaling and IVIVE to estimate human clearance, volume of distribution, and bioavailability from animal PK parameters → predicted human PK parameters

Run mechanistic whole-body PBPK simulation with compartmental organ clearance and optional renal/hepatic impairment submodels | mechanistic whole-body physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) simulation with organ-specific clearances and special population impairment models → tissue and plasma concentration-time profiles

Execute Monte Carlo sampling for population PK variability characterization and special population dose adjustment projection | Monte Carlo population pharmacokinetic simulation sampling physiological parameter distributions → population concentration profiles, variability bounds, and dose adjustment metrics

RNA-seq differential expression analysis to generate transcriptional signature | bulk RNA-seq quantification and differential expression analysis to produce a ranked differential gene expression signature (log2 fold change and adjusted p-values)

Find drugs with matching transcriptional signature using connectivity mapping and drug perturbation databases | transcriptional signature connectivity matching against drug perturbation profiles (LINCS L1000 / CMap) to prioritize candidate compounds

Population pharmacokinetic (PopPK) estimation pipeline with NONMEM primary execution and automatic nlmixr2 (R) fallback when NONMEM is unavailable. BYOL (Bring Your Own License) pattern: -- If NONMEM_HOME and NONMEM_LICENSE_FILE are set → run NONMEM nmfe75/nmfe74 -- Otherwise → fall back to nlmixr2 open-source R implementation Pipeline Steps: 1. -- Validate NONMEM-format dataset structure (ID, TIME, DV, etc.) 2. NONMEM_CTL_GENERATE -- Generate NO
test compound effect over time at 0, 6, 24, and 72 hours

Phase A: Central Nervous System (CNS) safety pharmacology simulation assessing neurobehavioral endpoints, modified Irwin test / FOB scores, locomotor activity, and body temperature changes. | in silico CNS safety pharmacology modeling — quantitative prediction of modified Irwin screen and Functional Observational Battery (FOB) scores, locomotor suppression/stimulation, and core body temperature liability → CNS safety toxicity profile and neurobehavioral scoring table

Phase B: Cardiovascular (CV) safety pharmacology simulation evaluating hemodynamics (MAP, systolic/diastolic blood pressure, heart rate) and cardiac electrophysiology (QT/QTc interval, PR, QRS, hERG/CiPA risk). | hemodynamic and cardiac electrophysiology simulation — quantitative modeling of mean arterial pressure (MAP), heart rate, ventricular repolarization (QT/QTc prolongation), and multi-channel cardiac ion current liabilities → cardiovascular safety report and proarrhythmic risk classification

Phase C: Respiratory system safety pharmacology simulation assessing respiratory rate, tidal volume, minute volume, and airway resistance liabilities. | respiratory safety pharmacology plethysmographic simulation — modeling alterations in respiratory rate (RR), tidal volume (Vt), minute volume (MV), and bronchoconstriction/airway resistance → respiratory safety response curves and ventilatory depression risk scores

Phase D: Integrated safety margin synthesis, therapeutic index evaluation, and ICH S7A regulatory dossier generation combining CNS, CV, and respiratory battery outputs against therapeutic exposure. | integrated safety margin and risk assessment synthesis — multi-organ integration of CNS, cardiovascular, and respiratory findings against projected therapeutic human free Cmax → safety margins (exposure/EC50 ratios), NOAEL cross-check, and ICH S7A summary dashboard report

Validate expression matrix and clinical metadata | validation and quality assessment of gene expression count/abundance matrix and matched clinical metadata table → validated expression and metadata datasets

Perform limma-voom transformation and linear modeling with covariates, eBayes moderation, and topTable extraction | differential gene expression analysis on RNA-seq counts using limma-voom linear modeling with covariate adjustment and empirical Bayes moderation → per-gene logFC and adjusted p-values table

Compute GSVA/ssGSEA gene signature scores on MSigDB hallmark gene sets and identify top enriched pathways per group | single-sample pathway enrichment scoring using GSVA or ssGSEA across the 50 MSigDB hallmark gene sets → sample enrichment score matrix and top differential pathways per group
Validate SMILES input file (one SMILES+ID per line) | validation and syntax checking of chemical structure SMILES input strings with compound identifiers → validated SMILES table
RDKit RECAP decomposition into scaffold + R-groups | chemical fragmentation using RDKit RECAP decomposition cleavage rules → molecular scaffolds and attached R-group fragments

mmpdb: identify matched molecular pairs and compute property deltas for fragment swaps | matched molecular pair indexing and transformation rule analysis using mmpdb → matched molecular pairs with property delta shifts

Rank novel scaffolds by frequency, drug-likeness, and SA score | prioritization and ranking of generated candidate scaffolds evaluated by observation frequency, drug-likeness filters, and synthetic accessibility score → ranked novel scaffold summary
